sentences.text: This petition has been filed seeking quashing of the FIR no. 726/2022 registered at PS Punjabi Bagh under Sections 498A/406/376/377/34 IPC on the basis of a settlement arrived at between the parties with the facilitation of Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Respondent no. 2 (complainant) is not present today; counsel for respondent no.2 states that she was unable to come to the Court today, she assures that respondent no.2 will be available on the next date of hearing.
In the meantime, Trial Court may adjourn the matter, without insisting on appearance of the parties, to a date after the next date before this Court.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
